topApps.description: Voice Memos turns your iPhone, iPad, or Apple Watch into a portable audio recorder, making it easy to capture and share personal notes, song ideas, family moments, classroom lectures, and more. Editing tools like trim, replace, and the new “Save As” feature let you fine-tune your recordings without altering the original. The transcription feature converts speech into text, simplifying the process of finding and referencing specific content. And the new feature to record a vocal layer on top of an existing instrumental recording* without the need for headphones making it easy to capture song ideas on the go. Users can then separate and edit the vocal and instrumental layers independently to continue expanding on those ideas. And with iCloud support, you can capture audio on the go with your iOS device, then use your Mac to do even more with your recordings. Features Record • Record using the built-in microphone, a Bluetooth headset, or a compatible external microphone. • Choose uncompressed audio for maximum sound fidelity, ensuring the highest quality recordings. • Opt for compressed audio to save storage space and record longer sessions. • Automatically name recordings based on your location. • Record a vocal layer* over an instrumental track without headphones. • Stereo recording adds greater depth and dimension to your audio**. • iCloud support keeps your recordings and edits in sync across all your devices, including iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, Mac, and Vision Pro. Edit • Pinch-to-zoom for more precision when editing. • Trim your recordings to save just the portion you want. • Replace and resume to fine-tune your recordings. • Save As lets you make edits and save them as a new recording without altering the original file. • Separate and independently edit the vocal and instrumental takes for layered recordings*. • Transcripts automatically convert speech into text for easy reference***. • Enhance Recording reduces background noise and room reverberation with a single tap. Organize • Quickly find recordings with the search feature. • Folders make it easy to organize your recordings. • Mark recordings as Favorites so you can quickly access them later. Listen and share • Speed up or slow down playback of your recordings, or jump 15 seconds forward or back. • Skip Silence analyzes your recordings and automatically skips over gaps in your audio. • Share multiple recordings at once via AirDrop, Mail, Messages, and more. • Import vocal layer* recordings into Logic Pro as a two-track project for advanced editing and production. * Adding a vocal layer on top of a Voice Memos recording is available only on the iPhone 16 Pro models. ** Stereo recording requires Apple devices equipped with stereo microphones and iOS 18 or later. *** Audio transcription is available on iPhone 12 and later in English (Australia), English (Canada), English (Ireland), English (New Zealand), English (South Africa), English (UK), and English (US).

Voicenotes transcribes your speech instantly, summarizes what matters, and lets you ask your AI to recall anything later. Record everything. Remember anything. Use Voicenotes to: Record meetings, reflections, ideas, and conversations Get accurate transcriptions in 100+ languages Summarize long recordings into short, clear takeaways Ask your AI to remember details, dates, and decisions Create content directly from your notes Search across everything you’ve recorded Works across all your devices: iOS MacOS WatchOS Works with your favorite tools: Notion Todoist Readwise WhatsApp (via bot) Zapier for custom workflows Great for journaling, team meetings, personal reminders — or just getting your thoughts down. topApps.description: Turn your voice into a structured journal — automatically. Just hit record and talk for 1-3 minutes. Our AI transcribes your audio, organizes your thoughts into clean journal entries, and detects your mood — all without typing a single word. Advanced features like smart task extraction and weekly AI digests are available with Premium (in-app purchase required). WHY VOICE JOURNALING? Speaking is 4x faster than typing. Most people want to journal but quit because it takes too long. Voice journaling removes that barrier entirely. Talk on your commute, during a walk, or before bed — and wake up to a beautifully structured reflection. HOW IT WORKS 1. Tap record and speak your thoughts 2. Your audio is sent to OpenAI Whisper for accurate transcription 3. The transcript becomes a structured journal entry with tags and mood 4. Review your emotional patterns over time KEY FEATURES ● Voice-to-Journal — Speak freely, get organized entries with automatic tags and basic mood detection ● AI Transcription — Powered by OpenAI Whisper for accuracy across many languages ● Mood Timeline — 7 days free; full history with Premium ● Smart Extraction (Premium) — AI pulls out to-dos, ideas, and decisions from your stream of consciousness ● Weekly Digest (Premium) — Get an AI summary of your week: key themes, progress, and insights ● Calendar View — Browse your entries by date, see your journaling streaks ● Transparent AI Use — Your audio and transcripts are sent to OpenAI only after you explicitly agree in the app. See Privacy Policy for details. PERFECT FOR • Busy professionals who want to reflect but don't have time to write • People with ADHD who find typing journals overwhelming • Anyone recommended journaling by their therapist • Commuters who want to use travel time for self-reflection • Anyone who thinks faster than they type FREE FEATURES • 2 voice entries per week (up to 1 minute each) • AI-powered transcription • Basic mood detection • 7-day mood timeline • Calendar view PREMIUM (auto-renewable subscription, in-app purchase) • Unlimited recording length and entries • Full mood timeline history • Weekly AI digest • Smart task & idea extraction • Full search history • Export to PDF/TXT • Advanced mood analysis Start your free trial today and discover how easy journaling can be when you just... talk. Privacy Policy: https://mindvox.space/legal/voice-journal/privacy/ Terms of Use: https://mindvox.space/legal/voice-journal/terms/ Support: support@mindvox.space

topApps.description: Never take meeting notes again. Otter AI is the fastest way to transcribe voice in real time. Get a meeting assistant that records audio, writes notes, automatically captures slides, and generates summaries. Available in English, Spanish, French and Japanese. Otter AI is also available on the web. Start for free. Trusted by over 10 million people and featured by Apple as "App of the Day" and "Editors' Choice." Automated meeting notes for Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, and more. Stay connected and collaborative when you work from home. Otter transcribes all your meetings, interviews, lectures, and everyday voice conversations in real time, so you can focus on the discussion. KEY FEATURES • AI Meeting Assistant: get automated meeting notes & summaries • AI Chat: get answers and generate content • AI Channels: combine live conversations with async updates. Chat with teammates. • Record & transcribe live • Automated meeting notes & summaries • Share & collaborate • All notes are searchable & shareable • Edit & highlight • Organize & export • Import & sync Looking for a specific feature? Here are the details: RECORD & TRANSCRIBE LIVE • Instantly record in one tap • Transcribe in real time • Highlight key points to review later • Insert photos of whiteboard discussions, slides, etc. • Input audio via built-in mic or Bluetooth device ENRICH NOTES WITH AI • Gather information across all your conversations • Ask questions about a specific meeting • Generate follow- up emails • Automated Slide Capture during virtual meetings • Generate summary, outline and keywords after all meetings • Punctuate, capitalize, and break paragraphs automatically SHARE & COLLABORATE • Invite group members to view, edit, and highlight collaboratively • Add comments and assign action items • Share links externally SEARCH & PLAYBACK • Search the text so you don't have to scrub through the whole audio • Playback at adjustable speeds • Follow along the highlighted word as the audio is playing • Tap on any word to jump the audio to that spot EDIT & HIGHLIGHT • Edit the text to correct any errors • Tag the speakers to label the paragraphs and train Otter to identify speakers too • Highlight sentences in one tap IMPORT & SYNC • Import audio and video files • Upload from other call recording apps • Sync your calendars to be reminded to record your meetings and auto-title your notes • Import your contacts for easy sharing OPTIMIZED FOR iOS • Start/Stop recording with Siri Shortcut & home widget • Record via AirPods • Sync with iOS Calendar, Contacts & Camera Otter Pro Get more playback speeds, skip silence, and bulk export. Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage your subscriptions in Settings and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to your Account Settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription. Need help? Check out our Help Center: https://help.otter.ai Terms of Service: https://otter.ai/terms-of-service Privacy Policy: https://otter.ai/privacy-policy

topApps.description: Voice Notes makes it easy to capture meetings, lectures, interviews, conversations, and ideas without typing. Record from your iPhone, iPad, or Apple Watch, then transcribe, search, organize, and revisit everything whenever you need it. Choose the transcription model that works best for you: Fast, Balanced, Accurate, or Max. PRIVACY FIRST TRANSCRIPTION Your recordings can be transcribed directly on your device. Your audio doesn’t need to be uploaded to the cloud just to turn it into text, giving you more privacy and the ability to transcribe even when you’re offline. EVERYTHING YOU NEED FOR YOUR VOICE NOTES • Fast, accurate speech-to-text with editable transcripts • Four transcription options: Fast, Balanced, Accurate, and Max • Record from iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch • Import existing audio and video files • Search across your transcripts and recordings • Organize recordings with folders and tags • Keep recording in the background • Transcribe multiple languages, including English, Spanish, Mandarin, French, and more • See word count, speaking pace, reading time, and sentiment • Start and follow recordings with Dynamic Island and Lock Screen features • Dark Mode support • Easily move your recordings when switching to a new device Voice Notes is free to start and includes 60 minutes of transcription each month. Upgrade to Voice Notes Pro to unlock: • Unlimited transcription • Max quality transcription models • AI powered summaries and action items • PDF and Word exports • More powerful tools for longer recordings and frequent use Contact Us: glassflagapps.com/contact Privacy Policy: glassflagapps.com/privacy Terms of Service: glassflagapps.com/terms

result.llmBrief: Keyword "voice notes" searched App Store term "voice notes" and analyzed 114 reviews from 5 apps (Voice Memos, Voicenotes AI Notes & Meetings, Voice Journal: AI Diary & Mood, Otter Transcribe Voice Notes, Voice Notes‎) over the requested 6 month window. Highest-priority roadmap clusters: pricing / subscription (0 requests, 7 complaints, 0 loves); support / customer service (0 requests, 2 complaints, 0 loves); reliability / bugs (0 requests, 2 complaints, 0 loves); performance / battery (0 requests, 1 complaints, 0 loves); videos / coaching (0 requests, 0 complaints, 2 loves); login / account (0 requests, 1 complaints, 0 loves). Use example reviews as evidence, not generic sentiment.
